name: webyansh-accessibility-suite
description: Accessibility & Compliance Suite for webyansh.com — WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA scanning with Webflow Designer remediation steps.
//scripts: Invoked via `node ./node_modules/...` rather than bare binary names.
npm's Windows shims mis-parse the '&' in this project's local path, so
`npx <bin>` and `npm run <script>` both fail with a truncated MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
Direct node paths behave identically on Webflow Cloud's Linux builder.

overrides: Transitive advisories in the build toolchain, forced to patched versions.
postcss: next@15.5.22 pins 8.4.31. GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp (<=8.5.22) is the newest of four.
sharp: next wants ^0.34.3, miniflare 0.35.2. GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj (libvips) needs >=0.35.0.
Not used at runtime — Workers has no Node image optimization pipeline.
undici: miniflare pins 7.28.0. Five advisories, all fixed in 7.29.0 (dev-only simulator).
